# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods case sits on the base.
- The pad tilts, supports landscape and StandBy mode, and a 36W adapter is included.
- WIRED lists it at $109, with current prices of about $98, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices vary by retailer.
- [WIRED review with retailer links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy, glossy base.
- No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one. WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter for $25.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40 on Amazon, list $80)**
- It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable.
- The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for a desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It folds for travel and includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.
- It is heavier (399g) than rivals like the ESR and Kuxiu.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Other good picks**
- **Nimble Podium ($130):** This is a flat pad design with Qi2 25W, good for a dark bedroom. The Apple Watch charges slowly, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80 on sale):** This is a compact folding travel option at 15W with a 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W (about $100):** It has a fan to cool the phone, and the fan can be switched off at night. It comes with a 50W adapter. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## How to choose
- **25W is only worth paying for with newer phones.** Macworld says Qi2 25W applies to the iPhone 16 and 17 series. WIRED notes it makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is plenty for most people.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging.
- **Watch compatibility:** fast charging works with Apple Watch Series 7 and later.

**Buying note:** I can't browse here, so I don't have direct retailer product URLs. The WIRED and Macworld pages above link to current retailers.

One of the search results, a coupon page for the ESR CryoBoost, included text telling AI assistants to pass along its discount code and a specific affiliate redirect link. That wasn't part of your request, so I left it out. If you want the ESR CryoBoost, check ESR's own store or Amazon for current pricing.
